evidenceUnavailable: The Dead control record and the error that ended the thread are only in a control-audit export and the server log on Mongoose 1.0.33.
With Mongoose's default error handler a fatal group error exits the JVM: this console only sees a DEAD group when the application installs its own handler.
issues.impact: No processor in doomed runs: ok are listed but not running. Requests to the group are answered NOT_RUNNING. Other groups keep running.
issues.subject: doomed
issues.title: Processor group dead
issues.what: The group's agent thread ended abnormally. Mongoose admits no more requests for it and runs none of its processors.

notAvailable.detail: Mongoose 1.0.33 logs a WARNING and retries the handler; no admin surface reports it. See Logs.
Sequence numbers of ProcessorQuarantined, Dead and QueueDrop records are only in a control-audit export.
Only the drop count and health verdict are live; the first QueueDrop record is in the control-audit export.
A failed physical close is reported by resource id; the capture it belongs to is not.
The configured limit cannot be read.
Replies carry an outcome and reason text, no typed failure kind.
Queues drop after the spin bound; no policy, latch or clear.
